info.name: VillagKart Partner API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for VillagKart Partner Panel APIs. Includes Health, Auth, Store, Supplier, Products, Orders, Delivery Settings (Types, Route Maps, Scheduled Slots, Route Pincodes, Pickup Slots, Warehouse Blackouts), Partner Categories (warehouse assortment), Product Management (Master Products, Import, Units, Unit Types, Brands, Categories, Subcategories, Toggle, CRUD, Ratings), and Variant Management (Create, Get, Update, Delete).

**Delivery Settings (base: /api/v1/partner/delivery-settings):**
- **MasterDeliverySetting** = global defaults (FAST, SCHEDULED, PICKUP_STORE); **WarehouseDeliverySetting** = per-warehouse overrides. GET /types and GET / return merged values (warehouse overrides when present, else Master).
- GET/PUT / — Get/update general settings (servicePincodes, opensAt, closesAt, pickupTimeSlots, isPickupStore, selfPickupMode)
- GET/PUT /types — Get/update delivery types; PUT body: { deliverySettings: [{ isEnabled, label, deliveryCharge? }] }, labels: Express Settings | Scheduled Delivery | Self Pickup. Updates WarehouseDeliverySetting only. Consumer API uses same logic (Warehouse + Master fallback).
- **Route Maps:** GET /route-maps (paginated), GET /route-maps/list (dropdown), GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /route-maps and /route-maps/:id. Area stored lowercase + trim.
- **Scheduled Slots:** GET /slots (paginated), GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /slots and /slots/:id. Create/Update: startTime/endTime within warehouse opensAt/closesAt. Syncs to Consumer DeliverySlot. Delete: 409 if orders use slot.
- **Route Pincodes:** POST /route-pincodes (routeMapId, pincodes 1–500), GET /route-pincodes?routeId=, DELETE /route-pincodes/:id. Test script saves createdIds[0] to routePincodeId.
- **Pickup Slots:** POST /pickup-slots (date, startTime, endTime, capacity, repeat), GET /pickup-slots?fromDate=&toDate=, GET/PUT/DELETE /pickup-slots/:id. Saves ids[0] to pickupSlotId.
- **Warehouse Blackouts:** POST /warehouse-blackouts (date, reason?), GET /warehouse-blackouts?fromDate=&toDate=, DELETE /warehouse-blackouts/:id. Saves id to blackoutId.
- E2E: Create Route Map → Create Route Pincodes → Create Slot → Create Pickup Slot → Create Blackout → List/Update/Delete as needed.

**Orders (by delivery type):**
- List Partner Orders – All delivery types (FAST + SCHEDULED + PICKUP_STORE)
- List Delivery Orders – FAST + SCHEDULED only
- List Pickup Store Orders – PICKUP_STORE only
- Get Delivery Agents, Get By ID, Accept, Reject, Update Status, Assign Agent. (Request Delivery OTP / Verify Delivery OTP have been removed as they are not implemented in the current codebase.)

**Product Management (base: /api/v1/productmanagement/product):**
- List, Get By ID, Create, Update, Get Pending, Update Status, Export Template, Upload Excel, Soft Delete, Ratings, Rating By ID.
- **Added:** Import Master Product (POST /import/masterproduct), Get Units by Unit Type (GET /units/:unitTypeId), Get Unit Types (GET /unittypes), Get Brands List, Get Categories List, Get Subcategories List, Toggle Product Status (PATCH /toggle/:productId). All require Bearer token.

**Variant Management (base: /api/v1/productmanagement/variant):**
- Create, Get by Product ID, Get by ID, Update, **Delete (Disable)** (DELETE /delete/:id). All require Bearer token.

**Setup:**
1. Set baseUrl (default: http://localhost:3004), emailOrPhone (partner@example.com or 9876543210).
2. Run "1. Partner Auth" → Login (email + password) to get accessToken.
3. Collection Runner: tokens and IDs (accessToken, productId, variantId, orderId, routeMapId, slotId, routePincodeId, pickupSlotId, blackoutId, unitTypeId, ratingId) auto-saved.

**Auth:** Login uses email+password or phone+password. OTP flows use emailOrPhone.

**Last updated:** 2026-03 (Added Partner Categories folder: Get Active Categories, Add/Get/Update Warehouse Categories. Added Get Master Products and Get Master Product By ID. Collection variables: masterProductId, unitTypeId auto-save from Get Unit Types/Get Master Products. E2E folder renumbered to 10.)

request.description:
**Use-case:** Verify API is running before running other requests.

**Response:** 200 – { message: 'VillagKart-Partner API is running', status: 'success', timestamp, version }.

**Tests:** Status 200; body has message and status.
Register a new partner. Returns user, store, supplier, accessToken, refreshToken.
Login with email OR phone + password. Provide either email or phone, not both.
Login with phone + password.

Send OTP for login. Use emailOrPhone: email (e.g. partner@example.com) or phone (e.g. 9876543210 or +919876543210). Email → OTP via email; Phone → OTP via SMS. Legacy: { phone, countryCode } also supported.
Legacy format: Send OTP to phone. Backward compatible.
Verify OTP and get accessToken, refreshToken. Use same emailOrPhone as Send OTP. Legacy: { phone, otp } also supported.
Legacy format: Verify OTP with phone. Backward compatible.
Resend OTP. Use same emailOrPhone as Send OTP. Email → OTP via email; Phone → OTP via SMS. Legacy: { phone } also supported.
Legacy format: Resend OTP to phone. Backward compatible.
Set password for approved partner (first-time setup). Requires Bearer token.
Get new accessToken using refreshToken.
Request OTP for password reset. Use emailOrPhone: email or phone. OTP sent via email or SMS accordingly. Legacy: { phone } also supported.
Legacy format: Request OTP for password reset via phone. Backward compatible.
Step 2: Verify OTP received after Forgot Password. Returns resetToken (auto-saved for Step 3). Body: emailOrPhone, otp.
Step 3: Set new password using resetToken from Step 2. Backend validates token and passwords. Password is updated and token is invalidated. On success redirect to Login.
Invalidate refresh token. Requires refreshToken in body.
Get current partner's store profile. Requires Bearer token.
Create store profile. Requires Bearer token.
Update store profile. All fields optional.
Get store approval/status.
Get store document URLs.
Get current partner's supplier profile.
Create supplier profile. businessAddress must include line1, city, state, pincode.
Update supplier profile.
Get supplier document URLs.
List partner's products with pagination.
Get product statistics for partner.
Get products below stock threshold.
Get single product by ID.
Create new product. warehouseId is required (UUID). Get from store/warehouse.
Update product. All fields optional.
Delete product by ID.

List ALL orders (all delivery types: FAST + SCHEDULED + PICKUP_STORE) assigned to partner's warehouse. Query: page, limit, status, search. Optional: deliveryType, routeMapId (when deliveryType=scheduled), cartType (single | group).

query.description: scheduled | express | fast. When scheduled, use routeMapId to filter by route.
Only when deliveryType=scheduled. Filter orders by delivery route (from route-maps/list).

request.description: List orders with delivery types FAST or SCHEDULED only (excludes PICKUP_STORE). Query: page, limit, status, search. Optional: deliveryType (scheduled | express | fast), routeMapId (when scheduled), cartType (single | group). Route options from GET /partner/delivery-settings/route-maps/list.
List orders with delivery type PICKUP_STORE only. Query: page, limit, status, search. Optional: cartType (single | group).

Partner/warehouse fetches list of delivery agents (for assigning orders). Returns active DELIVERY_AGENT users scoped to partner's warehouse or unassigned (warehouseId null). Fields: id, name, phone, email, isOnline, vehicleType, avatar.
Get order details by orderId (UUID). Requires order to belong to partner's warehouse.
Accept PENDING order (moves to CONFIRMED). No body required.
Reject PENDING order (moves to CANCELLED). Optional body: { "reason": "string" }.
Update order status. status: CONFIRMED | PROCESSING | READY_FOR_PICKUP | CANCELLED. Optional reason.
Assign order to a delivery partner (READY_FOR_PICKUP → ASSIGNED_TO_AGENT). Body: { agentId: UUID } (User with role DELIVERY_AGENT).

Get partner's delivery settings. Response: warehouse (id, name, servicePincodes, opensAt, closesAt, pickupTimeSlots, isPickupStore), deliveryChargeRules, deliverySlots, vendor (selfPickupMode, requireProductApproval), deliveryTypes (expressSettingsEnabled, selfPickupEnabled, scheduledDeliveryEnabled, defaultDeliveryCharge, scheduledDeliveryCharge). deliveryTypes are merged from MasterDeliverySetting + WarehouseDeliverySetting (warehouse overrides when present).

Update delivery settings. Body (all optional): servicePincodes (array), opensAt, closesAt (e.g. 09:00, 21:00), pickupTimeSlots (array or null), isPickupStore (boolean), selfPickupMode (boolean). At least one field required.

Get delivery type toggles. Defaults from MasterDeliverySetting when no WarehouseDeliverySetting; otherwise warehouse overrides apply. Response: deliverySettings array (isEnabled, label, deliveryCharge) for Express Settings, Scheduled Delivery, Self Pickup; defaultDeliveryCharge (from first type or 30).

Update delivery type toggles. Body: deliverySettings (required) — array of { isEnabled (boolean), label (Express Settings | Scheduled Delivery | Self Pickup), deliveryCharge or defaultDeliveryCharge (optional, non-negative).

List route maps (scheduled delivery areas) with pagination. Query: page (default 1), limit (default 10, max 100), search (matches area), sortBy (area|createdAt), sortOrder (asc|desc). Response includes pagination.
Get route map options for dropdowns (id, area). No pagination. Use returned id as routeMapId when creating delivery slots.

Create route map (delivery area). Body: area (required, string, max 255). Area is stored as lowercase + trim. Returns id, area, createdAt. Test script saves routeMapId for slot creation. 409 if area duplicate (case-insensitive).
Get single route map by ID (UUID). Path: :id. Uses {{routeMapId}}.
Update route map by ID. Body: area (optional, non-empty string, max 255). Area stored lowercase + trim. 409 if area duplicate (case-insensitive).
Delete route map by ID. 404 if not found or not owned by partner's warehouse.

List scheduled delivery slots with pagination. Query: page, limit (max 100), search (route area, startTime, endTime), sortBy (slotDate|createdAt|ordersPerSlot|startTime), sortOrder (asc|desc). Response includes routeArea, repeatLabel.

Create scheduled delivery slot. Body: slotDate (required, YYYY-MM-DD), startTime, endTime (required, HH:mm), routeMapId (required, UUID), ordersPerSlot (required, int ≥ 1). Optional: isRepeat, repeatType (ONCE|DAILY|WEEKLY|MON_FRI|SUN|CUSTOM), customDays. Validation: startTime/endTime must be within warehouse opensAt/closesAt (400 if outside). Slot is synced to Consumer DeliverySlot (key startTime-endTime, capacity = ordersPerSlot). Test script saves slotId.
Get single delivery slot by ID (UUID). Uses {{slotId}}. Response includes routeMap, routeArea, repeatLabel.

Update delivery slot by ID. Body (all optional): slotDate, startTime, endTime, routeMapId, ordersPerSlot (≥ 1), isRepeat, repeatType, customDays. Validation: if warehouse has opensAt/closesAt, slot time must be within that window (400 otherwise). Synced to Consumer DeliverySlot.

Delete delivery slot by ID. 404 if not found or not owned by partner's warehouse. 409 if any orders use this slot (same warehouse, date, slot key startTime-endTime); complete or cancel those orders first.

Bulk attach pincodes to a route. Body: routeMapId (required, UUID), pincodes (required, array of 1–500 non-empty strings). Duplicates for same route are skipped. Response: created, skipped, createdIds; test script saves first createdIds to routePincodeId. 409 if route not found or not owned by warehouse.
List route pincodes for partner's warehouse. Query: routeId (optional). Returns rows with id, routeMapId, pincode, createdAt.
Delete a single route pincode by ID. Uses {{routePincodeId}} (from Create Route Pincodes response createdIds). 404 if not found.

Create pickup slot(s). Body: date (required, YYYY-MM-DD), startTime, endTime (required, HH:mm), slot (optional), capacity (optional, 1–1000), repeat, repeatType (ONCE|DAILY|WEEKLY|MON_FRI|SUN|CUSTOM), customDays. With repeat=true creates multiple rows. Validates overlap. Response: created, ids; test script saves ids[0] to pickupSlotId. 409 if slot time overlaps.

List pickup slots for partner's warehouse with pagination. Required: page, limit. Optional: fromDate, toDate (date-range filter). Response includes data array and pagination (page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev).
Get single pickup slot by ID. Uses {{pickupSlotId}}. 404 if not found or not owned by warehouse.

Update pickup slot by ID. Body (all optional): date, startTime, endTime, slot, capacity (cannot be less than current booked), repeat, repeatType, customDays, isActive. 400 if capacity < booked or overlap; 404 if not found.
Delete pickup slot by ID. If slot has bookings (booked > 0), soft-deactivates (isActive: false); otherwise deletes. 404 if not found.

Add blackout date for warehouse. Body: date (required, YYYY-MM-DD), reason (optional, max 255 chars). Response includes id; test script saves to blackoutId. 409 if blackout already exists for this date.
List blackout dates for partner's warehouse. Query: fromDate, toDate (optional). Used by consumer API to hide blackout dates and filter pickup/scheduled slots.
Delete blackout by ID. Uses {{blackoutId}} (from Create Warehouse Blackout response). 404 if not found.
Get product list with filters and pagination. Requires Bearer token. Query: page, limit. Expected: 200 (success), 401 (unauthorized).

Import master products into partner warehouse. Body: masterProductIds (required, array of UUIDs). Creates products in partner's warehouse from master catalog. Expected: 200 (success), 400 (invalid/missing masterProductIds), 401.

**Use-case:** List master catalog products for import into warehouse (e.g. before calling Import Master Product).

**Response:** 200 – paginated list of MasterProduct. Query: page, limit, search, categoryId, isActive.

**Tests:** Status 200; body has data (array or paginated object).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); const d = j.data || j; if (d && d.length && d[0].id) pm.collectionVariables.set('masterProductId', d[0].id); }

request.description:
**Use-case:** Get single master product details by ID (e.g. before importing or for display).

**Response:** 200 – { success, data: MasterProduct, message }. 404 if not found.

**Tests:** Status 200 or 404. Set collection variable masterProductId from Get Master Products or use a known UUID.
Get units for a unit type. Path: unitTypeId (required). Query: page, limit, search, status. Expected: 200, 400 (missing unitTypeId), 401.
Get unit types list. Query: page, limit, search, status. Expected: 200, 401.
Get brands for dropdowns/filters. Query: page, limit, search, isActive (true|false), sortBy (priority), order (asc|desc). Expected: 200, 401.
Get categories list. Query: page, limit, search, isActive, sortBy (displayOrder), order. Expected: 200, 401.
Get subcategories list. Query: page, limit, search, categoryId, isActive, sortBy, order. Expected: 200, 401.
Toggle product isActive (true ↔ false). Path: productId (UUID). No body. Expected: 200 (returns updated product with isActive), 404 (product not found), 401.
Get single product by productId.
Create product. warehouseId required (UUID).
Update product.
Get products pending approval.
Update product status. status: APPROVED | REJECTED
Download Excel template for bulk product upload.
Bulk upload products via Excel. Use form-data with key 'file'.
Soft delete product.
Get all product ratings.
Get rating by ID. Path: ratingId. Expected: 200, 404, 401.
Create product variant. productId, sku, variantName, unitType, landingPrice required.
Get all variants for a product.
Get single variant by ID.
Update variant. Path: variantId (UUID). Body (optional): sku, variantName, unitType, landingPrice, stockQuantity. Expected: 200, 404, 401.
Disable/delete variant by ID. Path: variantId (UUID). Endpoint: DELETE /variant/delete/:id. Expected: 200/204 (success), 404 (variant not found), 401.

**Use-case:** Fetch all active categories with their active subcategories for dropdowns/forms (e.g. when adding warehouse categories).

**Response:** 200 – { success, data: [{ id, name, description, image, displayOrder, slug, subCategories: [{ id, name, ... }] }], message }. Used to get categoryId and subCategoryIds for Add/Update Warehouse Categories.

**Tests:** Status 200; body has data array.

exec: pm.test('Response has data array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description:
**Use-case:** Enable categories and subcategories for the partner's warehouse (assortment). Run after Get Active Categories to get categoryId and subCategoryIds.

**Request:** Body: { categories: [{ categoryId (UUID), subCategoryIds (optional array of UUIDs) }] }. Warehouse is derived from authenticated user.

**Response:** 201 – { success, data: [WarehouseCategory], message }. 400 if warehouse not assigned or categories missing.

**Tests:** Status 201 or 400.

**Use-case:** List categories and subcategories currently enabled for the partner's warehouse (for display or edit).

**Response:** 200 – { success, data: [{ id, categoryId, categoryName, image, icon, subCategories: [{ id, name, image }] }], message }. 400 if warehouse not assigned.

**Tests:** Status 200; body has data array.

exec: pm.test('Response has data array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description:
**Use-case:** Replace warehouse category-subcategory mapping. Removes subcategories not in subCategoryIds; adds new ones. Same body shape as Add.

**Request:** Body: { categories: [{ categoryId, subCategoryIds (optional array) }] }.

**Response:** 200 – { success, data: null, message }. 400 if categories missing or warehouse not assigned.

**Tests:** Status 200 or 400.

**Run all Partner APIs at once (E2E):**

1. Postman → Click the collection → **Run** (Collection Runner)
2. Select environment: VillagKart Partner - Local
3. Select all folders (or leave default to run all)
4. Click **Run VillagKart Partner API** — all requests execute in order; tokens and IDs auto-save
5. Order: Health → Auth (Login/Verify OTP or Register) → Store → Supplier → Products → Orders → Delivery Settings → Product Management → Variant → Partner Categories → Logout. Password reset: Forgot Password → Verify Reset OTP (saves resetToken) → Reset Password
6. Pre-requisites: Valid partner account; set emailOrPhone for OTP; warehouseId for product creation. Optional: run Get Unit Types first to auto-fill unitTypeId for Get Units by Unit Type; run Get Master Products to fill masterProductId.
7. Test script: Status 2xx/4xx validated; accessToken, refreshToken, resetToken, productId, variantId, orderId, warehouseId, routeMapId, slotId, routePincodeId, pickupSlotId, blackoutId, ratingId, unitTypeId, masterProductId extracted for subsequent requests.
